name: sci-review
description: Review code for scientific correctness with a panel of independent reviewers: mathematical derivations, numerical stability, physical modelling and units, statistical integrity, and algorithmic correctness. Not a style, lint or documentation review.

interface.shortDescription: Panel review of code for scientific correctness
interface.longDescription: Run a panel of independent reviewers (theorist, numerical analyst, experimentalist, methodologist, computer scientist), a defender and a moderator over a branch, a repository or selected paths, and report evidenced findings on mathematics, numerics, physical modelling and units, statistics and algorithms, each labelled by the panel's agreement.
defaultPrompt: Review this branch for scientific correctness
Check the numerical stability of src/solver
Check this pipeline for data leakage
